field_schema.id: Unique stable identifier for the artifact entry.
field_schema.local_path: POSIX path relative to repository root, rooted under local/{data,evidence,archive}/.
field_schema.sha256: 64-hex SHA-256 for single-file entries (null for directory entries using manifest_sha256).
field_schema.manifest_file: For directory entries, relative path inside local_path to MANIFEST.sha256 or MANIFEST.json (null if none).
field_schema.manifest_sha256: 64-hex SHA-256 of manifest_file (null if no manifest file).
field_schema.dir_content_sha256: 64-hex content-based SHA-256 over sorted '<relpath>\0<file_sha256>\n' for directory entries without a manifest file (null when manifest_sha256 is used).
field_schema.purpose: Which experiment or document references this artifact.
field_schema.cloud_location: Private cloud drive folder/item label (empty string in Git; filled privately by Codex/user per D380/D384).
field_schema.rebuildable: Boolean indicating whether the artifact can be cheaply rebuilt from code without paid API calls or original Blender renders.
field_schema.rebuild_how: How to rebuild, or why it cannot be cheaply rebuilt.
